caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest placed on a plain, light beige background. The chest is rectangular with brown wood grain visible across its surfaces, rendered to show natural texture and variations in tone. It has a flat top and stands on four low bracket feet. On the front of the chest, there are two drawers at the base, each fitted with a gold-colored handle, and a larger compartment above them with a central, matching gold-colored decorative clasp. The perspective allows partial visibility of the right side of the chest, where the wood grain continues. There are no other objects or embellishments in the composition, and the chest is centered on the page. The lower right-hand corner contains a small, handwritten inscription.
title: Chest
